(a)

SECTION-1 PRELIMINARIES & EARTHWORKS
SITE CLEARANCE
Ref. Spec. No. 1.2.1
Site clearing shall consist of the removal and disposal of all small trees,
stumps, roots, logs, shrubs, grass, weeds, other surface litter and make
it ready for machinery movement etc., wherever they occur within plot
limit and within such other areas as directed and staked out by The
Engineer. Complete in all respect as per the drawings, specifications and
instructions by The Engineer.

1

SECTION-2 CONCRETE WORKS
Reinforcement for Concrete
Ref. Spec. No. 2.2, 2.5
Installation of steel reinforcement deformed steel bars conforming to
ASTM A-615, including cleaning, cutting, bending, placing, binding &
fixing etc., including provision and cost of spacers, binder wire,
stiffeners and over-laps not shown in drawings etc., in any kind of R.C.C
works, complete in all respect as per the drawings, Specification and
instructions of The Engineer
(only Steel Shall be provided by The Employer).

2

a)

Steel Reinforcement deformed bars
Structural Concrete (Designed Mix)
Laying/Pouring of Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC) including
surveying, fair-faced formwork and its removal, placing, compacting,
finishing, curing etc. and excavation (if required) complete in all respects
as per drawings, specifications and instructions of The Engineer.
Concrte shall be provided by The Employer (excluding the cost of
concrete).

a)

Capping Beams
SECTION-16 PILING WORKS
BORED CAST IN PLACE RCC PILES
Ref. Spec. No. 16.2

4

Construction of Cast in Place 24" dia Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC)
Piles; including surveying , Boring, Lowering of Cage, Concrete Casting,
Excavation/dewatering (if required), dismantling of existing/dirty
concrete and removal/disposal of surplus material up to any lead and
Lift, complete in all respect as per the drawings, specifications and
instructions by The Engineer.
Excluding cost of steel reinforcement & concrete "Steel reinforcement
& concrete shall be provided by The Employer".
